p: Gaza: Or Azzah, a city of the Philistines.
north: He means the army of the Chaldeans, Isa 8:7,8.
the fathers shall not look back: The great fear will take away their natural affection.
hands: Their heart will so fail them.
Caphtor: For the Caphtorims had destroyed in old time the Philistines, and dwelt in their land even to Gaza, De 2:23.
Baldness is come upon Gaza: They who shaved their heads for sorrow and heaviness.
thou cut thyself: As the heathen used in their mourning, which the Lord forbade his people to do, De 14:1.
quiet: Meaning, that it is not profitable that the wicked should by any means escape or hinder the Lord when he will take vengeance.
